sources: Artificial Analysis (artificialanalysis.ai), LMArena (lmarena.ai), vendor model cards, OpenRouter

rows: Strong at math (though measured by few benchmarks), reasoning, writing and conversation, solidly above average at coding, debugging, software engineering and science, and moderately strong at long context, agentic tool use and document understanding. Instruction following is only middling. Computer use, web research, vision and knowledge work look strong but are estimated rather than directly measured. It gains heavily from higher reasoning effort, with most scores rising about 15-30 points from none to max. It is expensive, with a 1M-token context window and a live median speed of about 61 tok/s.

Top-tier across nearly every measured capability, especially math, agentic tool use, computer use, instruction following, long context and science, with strong coding, debugging and software engineering and slightly less standout writing and conversation. It gains moderately from higher reasoning effort, most notably in math and science (about 11 points from low to max), while web research, knowledge work and document understanding look very strong but are measured by only a few benchmarks, and vision is not directly measured. It is very expensive at $10/$50 per 1M tokens (95th percentile) and runs at a modest 47-63 tok/s, with a 1M-token context, tool calling, text/image/file inputs and 99.8% uptime.
